lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Wednesday's San Miguel County BOCC meeting, where commissioners will hold public hearings on three Land Use Code amendments — including changes to who qualifies as a deed-restricted owner, a wildfire-area code update, and nonconforming lots, all moving toward formal votes. Monday the Open Space Commission takes up the Valley Floor River Trail alignment, with three routes through sensitive wetlands on the table, and the Housing Authority subcommittee weighs in on a deed-restriction variance for a homeowner facing a $47,000 roof replacement.

notable.stake: Commissioners choose one of three Valley Floor River Trail alignments near wetlands.
Board decides whether to let a deed-restricted homeowner exceed capital-improvement cost limits.
Public hearings on three Land Use Code changes, including who qualifies as a deed-restricted owner.
